cuts.head: turn_side
cuts.placeText: a seaside lighthouse — a white tower with a spiral stair, a railing, rocky shore and a starry sunset sea
cuts.scene: she is a trainee with one foot on the stair gazing at the faint horizon, learning the light schedule
cuts.outfit: a lighthouse keeper look fitted to her body — a fitted sleeveless sailor top and short pleated skirt with deck shoes, bare shoulders and legs, a plain star-shaped button
